theory Compiler

Verified compiler

Expression language, stack machine bytecode, compiler correctness, and execution theorems.

Verified stack machine compiler for arithmetic and variable expressions.

This theory formalizes: 1. Bytecode instruction set (IPush, ILoad, IAdd, IMul) and stack state. 2. Single-step transition semantics `Step` and sequence execution `Exec`. 3. Algebraic execution laws, including sequential execution composition over `Append`. 4. Expression compilation into bytecode streams. 5. Compiler correctness theorems for atomic and compound expressions. 6. Direct execution of compiled bytecode programs inside the NuPRL kernel.

19 theorems, 15 abstractions, checked by replaying their tactic scripts on the kernel. Hover any piece of syntax for its kind, surface form, and uniform term; open Tactics, Proof, or Analysis to go deeper.

Original source file
-- | Verified stack machine compiler for arithmetic and variable expressions.
--
-- This theory formalizes:
-- 1. Bytecode instruction set (IPush, ILoad, IAdd, IMul) and stack state.
-- 2. Single-step transition semantics `Step` and sequence execution `Exec`.
-- 3. Algebraic execution laws, including sequential execution composition over `Append`.
-- 4. Expression compilation into bytecode streams.
-- 5. Compiler correctness theorems for atomic and compound expressions.
-- 6. Direct execution of compiled bytecode programs inside the NuPRL kernel.
theory Compiler

comment book "Verified stack machine compilation and evaluation of arithmetic expressions."

abs Stack == List Int
abs Env == List (Atom × Int)

-- Bytecode instructions:
--   IPush(n)       inl n
--   ILoad(x)       inr (inl x)
--   IAdd           inr (inr (inl Ax))
--   IMul           inr (inr (inr Ax))
abs IPush(n) == inl n
abs ILoad(x) == inr (inl x)
abs IAdd == inr (inr (inl Ax))
abs IMul == inr (inr (inr Ax))
abs Instr == Int ⊎ (Atom ⊎ (True ⊎ True))

abs Append(xs; ys) == list_ind xs (ys) (h, t, ih. h :: ih)

abs Lookup(d; x; env) ==
  list_ind env (d) (entry, tl, ih.
    atom_eq (let <k, val> = entry in k) x
      (let <k, val> = entry in val)
      ih)

abs Step(i; s; env) ==
  decide i of
    inl n => n :: s
  | inr r =>
      decide r of
        inl x => Lookup(0; x; env) :: s
      | inr op =>
          decide op of
            inl u =>
              list_ind s ([]) (a, s1, _.
                list_ind s1 ([]) (b, s2, _. (b + a) :: s2))
          | inr v =>
              list_ind s ([]) (a, s1, _.
                list_ind s1 ([]) (b, s2, _. (b * a) :: s2))

-- Exec folds instructions from left to right:
abs Exec(code; s; env) ==
  list_ind code (λst. st) (i, rest, ih. λst. ih (Step(i; st; env))) s

-- Compilation combinators:
abs CompileConst(n) == IPush(n) :: []
abs CompileVar(x) == ILoad(x) :: []
abs CompileAdd(c1; c2) == Append(Append(c1; c2); IAdd :: [])
abs CompileMul(c1; c2) == Append(Append(c1; c2); IMul :: [])

soft Stack, Env, IPush, ILoad, IAdd, IMul, Instr
soft Append, Lookup, Step, Exec
soft CompileConst, CompileVar, CompileAdd, CompileMul

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Step reduction equations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem step_push :
  ∀n:Int. ∀s:Stack. ∀env:Env.
    Step(IPush(n); s; env) = n :: s ∈ Stack
proof
  intro n
  intro s
  intro env
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem step_load :
  ∀x:Atom. ∀s:Stack. ∀env:Env.
    Step(ILoad(x); s; env) = Lookup(0; x; env) :: s ∈ Stack
proof
  intro x
  intro s
  intro env
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem step_add :
  ∀a:Int. ∀b:Int. ∀s:Stack. ∀env:Env.
    Step(IAdd; a :: b :: s; env) = (b + a) :: s ∈ Stack
proof
  intro a
  intro b
  intro s
  intro env
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem step_mul :
  ∀a:Int. ∀b:Int. ∀s:Stack. ∀env:Env.
    Step(IMul; a :: b :: s; env) = (b * a) :: s ∈ Stack
proof
  intro a
  intro b
  intro s
  intro env
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Execution properties
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem exec_nil :
  ∀s:Stack. ∀env:Env.
    Exec([]; s; env) = s ∈ Stack
proof
  intro s
  intro env
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem exec_cons :
  ∀i:Instr. ∀code:List Instr. ∀s:Stack. ∀env:Env.
    Exec(i :: code; s; env) = Exec(code; Step(i; s; env); env) ∈ Stack
proof
  intro i
  intro code
  intro s
  intro env
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem exec_singleton :
  ∀i:Instr. ∀s:Stack. ∀env:Env.
    Exec(i :: []; s; env) = Step(i; s; env) ∈ Stack
proof
  intro i
  intro s
  intro env
  reduce
  eq
qed

theorem exec_push :
  ∀n:Int. ∀s:Stack. ∀env:Env.
    Exec(IPush(n) :: []; s; env) = n :: s ∈ Stack
proof
  intro n
  intro s
  intro env
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem exec_load :
  ∀x:Atom. ∀s:Stack. ∀env:Env.
    Exec(ILoad(x) :: []; s; env) = Lookup(0; x; env) :: s ∈ Stack
proof
  intro x
  intro s
  intro env
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem exec_add :
  ∀a:Int. ∀b:Int. ∀s:Stack. ∀env:Env.
    Exec(IAdd :: []; a :: b :: s; env) = (b + a) :: s ∈ Stack
proof
  intro a
  intro b
  intro s
  intro env
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem exec_mul :
  ∀a:Int. ∀b:Int. ∀s:Stack. ∀env:Env.
    Exec(IMul :: []; a :: b :: s; env) = (b * a) :: s ∈ Stack
proof
  intro a
  intro b
  intro s
  intro env
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Execution composition over Append
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem exec_append_nil :
  ∀c2:List Instr. ∀s:Stack. ∀env:Env.
    Exec(Append([]; c2); s; env) = Exec(c2; Exec([]; s; env); env) ∈ Stack
proof
  intro c2
  intro s
  intro env
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem exec_append_step :
  ∀i:Instr. ∀c1:List Instr. ∀c2:List Instr. ∀s:Stack. ∀env:Env.
    Exec(Append(i :: c1; c2); s; env) =
      Exec(Append(c1; c2); Step(i; s; env); env) ∈ Stack
proof
  intro i
  intro c1
  intro c2
  intro s
  intro env
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Compiler correctness on atomic expressions
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem exec_compile_const :
  ∀n:Int. ∀s:Stack. ∀env:Env.
    Exec(CompileConst(n); s; env) = n :: s ∈ Stack
proof
  intro n
  intro s
  intro env
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem exec_compile_var :
  ∀x:Atom. ∀s:Stack. ∀env:Env.
    Exec(CompileVar(x); s; env) = Lookup(0; x; env) :: s ∈ Stack
proof
  intro x
  intro s
  intro env
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem exec_compile_add :
  ∀a:Int. ∀b:Int. ∀s:Stack. ∀env:Env.
    Exec(CompileAdd(CompileConst(a); CompileConst(b)); s; env) =
      (a + b) :: s ∈ Stack
proof
  intro a
  intro b
  intro s
  intro env
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem exec_compile_mul :
  ∀a:Int. ∀b:Int. ∀s:Stack. ∀env:Env.
    Exec(CompileMul(CompileConst(a); CompileConst(b)); s; env) =
      (a * b) :: s ∈ Stack
proof
  intro a
  intro b
  intro s
  intro env
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem eval_arith_program :
  Exec(CompileMul(CompileAdd(CompileConst(2); CompileConst(3)); CompileConst(4)); []; []) =
    20 :: [] ∈ Stack

  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

-- Evaluate x + 5 with environment { x = 10 }:
theorem eval_var_program :
  Exec(CompileAdd(CompileVar("x"); CompileConst(5)); []; <"x", 10> :: []) =
    15 :: [] ∈ Stack
proof
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
